tagline.en_US: RPCS3 is a multi-platform open-source Sony PlayStation 3 emulator and debugger written in C++ for Windows, Linux, macOS and FreeBSD.

description.en_US: RPCS3 is an open-source Sony PlayStation 3 emulator and debugger. It enables modern operating systems and hardware to run and analyze PlayStation 3 software and games. The platform provides configurable settings for system components, graphical rendering, audio output, and controller inputs.

tips: For gamepads to function select SDL as the gamepad driver under "Handlers".
